meta.name: Couple Goals
meta.description:
What are the Couple Goals? Having fun together, getting comfortable, and trusting one another are a few of them. You actually have to face some embarrassing and funny moments to achieve these goals. Being in a relationship is a two-way street. Only setting up goals won't help unless you actually execute them together.

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 13 Feb 2021 · India · Language: Hindi · 14 min
Studio: Rusk Media · Network: YouTube, Amazon miniTV

videos.title: Couple vs. Couple
videos.overview: The most beautiful things about relationships is that they aren't all the same and setting couple goals creates new interests, joy, and long term fulfillment. They add significant meaning to a relationship. Couple goals could be a road map in a relationship.

videos.title: Couple & In-Laws
videos.overview: Whether you just tied a knot, or you have been married for years, creating a bucket list can make the bond even stronger. The ultimate bucket list includes not just romantic things but also sweet relationship-focused activities. From spending time with each other to enjoy each other's differences.

videos.title: Couple & House Party
videos.overview: Marriage is not a piece of cake. There will be a few ups and downs. And a lot changes once the couple is finally hitched and here are a few things that only newlywed couples will be able to relate to. Are you ready to witness such a new chapter of love? So make sure to watch this video till the end.
